title: fix(auth): label the external organization role objectstack#25515 added, so the console type-checks against objectstack main (objectui#13427)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCB2j33nwkf8zRiRLVnonR8)_

Closes #13427
Clause-②: yes (follows objectstack#25515's widening: a new `ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL` export and `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` row in `@object-ui/auth`, a new `organization.roles.external` key in each shipped pack; no acceptance set of objectui's own widens)

## What changed

objectstack#25515 (objectstack#25233 stage 1, ruling of record 6355206139, letter B) added `external` to `@objectstack/spec`'s `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLES`. `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` is a `Record` over that vocabulary, so the console stopped type-checking against objectstack `main` (`TS2741` at `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts:67`), and objectstack's Console Pin Gate and Spec Shape Gate went red. This PR makes the console know the role:

- `packages/auth/src/org-roles.ts`: a new `ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL` export, its label row (`organization.roles.external`, "External"), and the any-issuer rule for invitations (below).
- Every pack in `packages/i18n/src/locales/` carries `organization.roles.external`. zh is 外部成员, ja 外部メンバー and es Externo, the words objectstack's own `sys_member.role` option uses; de, fr, ko, pt, ru and ar follow each pack's word for `member`.

## The two choices the card asked for

1. **Where the role shows.** `ORG_ROLES` stays the spec list unfiltered, so `external` appears in the invite dialog and in the members page's role menu wherever the spec lists it. The invite offer for an issuer below admin grade (a delegated admin, or a caller whose membership has not loaded) becomes `member` and `external`. That mirrors the framework's invitation cap: in the spec's grant table (`INVITATION_ROLE_GRANTORS`) both rows read `'any'`, because `external` confers less than a member (ruling E3). An owner or admin may also set it from the members page, as better-auth's `update-member-role` allows. Two server refusals are not pre-empted, because the screen cannot see what they read: a role list mixing `external` with another role (E5; the menu sets one role) and re-roling a member who is placed in a business unit (E6).
2. **Where it sits on the grade ladder.** At `member` grade, as objectstack's own cap ladder (`invitation-role-cap.ts`) grades it. The console ladder answers only "is this an administrative grade", so `external` never unlocks invite, remove, cancel or re-role. That it reaches less than a member is enforced server-side; a rung below `member` here would have no reader.

## Why the pin does not move, and the literal

Importing the spec's `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL` needs objectui's own `.objectstack-sha` past objectstack#25515. Any such pin also carries objectstack#25483, PR1 of objectstack#25251, whose PR2 (spec lane) has not landed; this project keeps objectui's pin before #25483 until it does. So the pin stays at `915e9404`, and the console compiles against both vocabularies:

- `ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL = 'external'` is spelled locally, with a docblock pointing at objectstack#25515.
- `ORG_ROLE_LABELS` is typed `Record<OrgRole | typeof ORG_ROLE_EXTERNAL, …>`. Against `main` the union is `OrgRole` itself, so the table stays exhaustive there.
- A tripwire test (`spells external itself only while the pin predates objectstack#25515`) goes red on the pin move that brings #25515. Its message lists the follow-up: import the constant, drop the union, add `external` to the role lists that `InviteMemberDialog.roleCap.test.tsx` and `org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx` expect, and delete the tripwire.

## Tests

- `org-roles.test.ts`: the external label row; external grades as `member` and below admin; an external actor may re-role nobody; an admin may re-role an existing external; and the invite offer equals what the spec's grant table admits, for owner, admin and every below-admin issuer. That last pin holds at either spec, and against `main` it asserts `['member', 'external']` for a delegate.
- `org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx`: every pack defines `organization.roles.external`, and an external member's badge reads 外部成员 in zh and External in en.

## Verification

Measured in this container, in the worktree on this branch:

- **Against objectstack `main` `5ea211cc`** (the pin built at that commit, nothing committed): `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/auth --filter=@object-ui/i18n`, then `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`: exit 0, 39/39 tasks (console runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -b tsconfig.node.json`, app-shell its test tsconfig too). `vitest run` on `org-roles.test.ts` plus `console/organizations/__tests__/`: 159 passed, 6 failed, all six expected. The tripwire is one of them. The other five are the existing literal role lists, whose received values show the new behaviour: owner offered 5 roles, delegate and unloaded offered `['member', 'external']`, and the zh and en dropdowns ending in 外部成员 and External. Ablation on the same build: restoring the old below-admin offer (`[ORG_ROLE_MEMBER]`) turns `offers exactly what the spec grant table admits` red.
- **At the pin `915e9404`** (after `pnpm run setup`; `objectstack-pin status` reads the cache at the pin): the same build and type-check, exit 0, 39/39 tasks; `vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/ packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/ packages/i18n/ apps/console/src/pages/system/`: 168 files, 2019 passed, 13 skipped, 0 failed. `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors (17 warnings, all pre-existing `any` lines in the holdouts test's mocks).
- Repo checks, each exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`. `check:readme-exports` answered exit 1 as a prerequisite, not a verdict: 27 packages were unbuilt, so its population collapsed below its floors. CI runs it after the build.

## Notes

- Branch `claude/issue-13427-external-role-label`, worktree `objectui-issue-13427`, claim 6374956587 (Seat: `domain:ui#1`).
- After this merges, objectstack-ai/objectstack#25537 moves objectstack's `.objectui-sha` past it, which greens Console Pin Gate and Spec Shape Gate.
- Not changed, outside the surface: the profile page's access word is two-way (admin or member, from `useWorkspaceAdminStatus`), so an external user reads 成员 / Member there. `orgRoleLabel.ts`'s docblock still says "the four" roles.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
